newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on interbank and retail interest, dealers said on Thursday.

"Government securities closed narrowly mixed today amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market. Treasury bill yields were slightly higher but bond prices were slightly lower. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 2.54/2.49 percent compared with Wednesday's yield of 2.45/2.40 percent and one-year at a yield of 2.16/2.11 percent against 2.12/2.07 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$97.93/97.98 from Wednesday's close of S$98.06/98.11, September 2001 at S$97.55/97.60 versus S$97.89/97.94 and June 2003 at S$96.50/96.55 against S$96.89/96.94.
The overnight interbank offered rate was unchanged from Wednesday's 3-1/4 3-1/8 percent.
